detail.title: Synthesis of Prebiotic Heredity and Autocatalytic Memory
detail.summary: This update synthesizes current research on autocatalytic memory and heredity thresholds, integrating thermodynamic and stoichiometric models to define transitions from chemical persistence to heritable information.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Autocatalytic Memory
detail.summary: Autocatalytic networks establish memory through stoichiometric constraints that enable bistability and history-dependent state transitions, moving beyond simple persistence.
detail.reason: Revision based on stoichiometric matrix constraints and thermodynamic modeling.

detail.title: Compositional Heredity and Thermodynamic Persistence in Prebiotic Networks
detail.summary: Prebiotic evolution requires a transition where information storage becomes thermodynamically stable, linked to reaction network resilience and error thresholds.
detail.reason: Revision integrating thermodynamic models of selection emergence.

children.title: Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Chemical Systems

detail.title: Heredity Thresholds in Prebiotic Chemical Systems
detail.summary: Heritability requires overcoming error thresholds that constrain the fidelity of non-templated chemical copying.
detail.reason: Revision focusing on the foundational question of when heritability precedes genes.
